parsed.rationale: V1-V4 show deep rS/QS complexes with discordant, concave ST elevation and upright T waves, while the lateral leads (I, V5, V6) have small QRS complexes without ST changes. This fits an LBBB-type pattern with expected discordant ST elevation. It does not meet STEMI criteria, but I am only moderately confident: the QRS looks fairly narrow, so another cause of anterior ST elevation is possible.
